verdict.rationale: Bland supports batch calls, webhooks, pathways, and scheduled/triggered call campaigns that run without manual intervention, which constitute a form of autonomous background automation for voice workflows. However, this is scoped to phone-call automation only, not general-purpose background task/agent scheduling. missing for 10: evidence of a generic scheduler/cron-like trigger system, independent hands-on validation of unattended background runs, and confirmation of failure handling/monitoring for long-running autonomous automations.
